audience: fraud prevention and operations teams using IPDetective

useCases.title: Check the remaining lookup allowance
useCases.text: Read account request and lookup limits alongside current usage before investigating addresses.

useCases.title: Investigate an unfamiliar IP address
useCases.text: Look up a public IP for bot, VPN, proxy, ASN and country signals where available. Use the results as investigation context rather than proof of abuse.

useCases.title: Review a batch of suspicious addresses
useCases.text: Confirm allowance usage to investigate up to 100 public IP addresses in one request. Review the returned signals and check usage before repeating an uncertain request.
